title: LiteRT INT8：零點、尺度與量化誤差
titleEn: LiteRT INT8: zero points, scales and quantization error
summary: 正確處理零點與範圍，量化前後誤差按同一實值尺度比較。
summaryEn: Handle zero point and range correctly, and compare quantization errors in real-value units.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.
